title: How is FDR connected to Lee Jung-jae?
description: Four real photos connect Franklin D. Roosevelt to Squid Game star Lee Jung-jae.
hook: What links FDR to Lee Jung-jae?

image.file: File:The Roosevelts with the King and Queen of England sailing on the USS Potomac, June 9, 1939 (cropped).jpg

links.line: In 1939, Roosevelt took Britain's King George the Sixth out sailing.

image.file: File:Royal Air Force Bomber Command, 1942-1945. CH20901.jpg

links.line: In the 1940s, the King and his daughter, Princess Elizabeth, visited bomber crews.

image.file: File:Prime Minister Boris Johnson G7 Summit Day One - 51242021245.jpg

links.line: In 2021, Queen Elizabeth hosted Emmanuel Macron and other G7 leaders in Cornwall.
And in 2025, Macron posed with Squid Game star Lee Jung-jae.
